en.quote: And thou shalt command the priests that bear the ark of the covenant, saying, When ye are come to the brink of the water of Jordan, ye shall stand still in Jordan.
en.riddle: When ye are come to the brink of the waters of the Jordan, ye shall stand still in the Jordan
en.speaker: thou shalt command the priests

he.quote: וְאַתָּה תְּצַוֶּה אֶת-הַכֹּהֲנִים נֹשְׂאֵי אֲרֽוֹן-הַבְּרִית לֵאמֹר כְּבֹאֲכֶם, עַד-קְצֵה מֵי הַיַּרְדֵּן, בַּיַּרְדֵּן, תַּעֲמֹדוּ
he.riddle: כְּבֹאֲכֶם, עַד-קְצֵה מֵי הַיַּרְדֵּן, בַּיַּרְדֵּן, תַּעֲמֹדוּ
he.speaker: וְאַתָּה, תְּצַוֶּה אֶת-הַכֹּהֲנִים
